visual_requirements.description: Respectful human-form interpretation of the goddess Radha; fully clothed adult woman, one head, two arms, two eyes. Exact anatomy and costume are editorial, not specified in claims.
Visually imposing queenly presentation for queen of Goloka and Braj, with a large ornate gold crown and modest crimson-gold sari as editorial royal dress.
Active rasa-dance turn with flowing cloth and visibly extended arm, expressing her epithets queen of Raslila and fond of the rasa dance; no supernatural effect is invented.
Spring woodland compressed to the edges of the frame, grounded in the Gita Govinda woodland episode; queen herself dominates.
Divine grandeur through tightly framed royal dance, compassion and devotional intensity rather than hostility, respectful of traditions venerating her as supreme being. Lighting remains natural.

prompt:
ONE original NEW square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of RADHA, Hindu goddess of love, compassion and devotion, queen of Goloka and Braj, honored as supreme being in Radha Vallabha and Haridasi traditions. This correction MUST look like an overwhelming sacred queen actively dancing, never an ordinary woman standing in a garden. [radha-c01, radha-c03, radha-c07, radha-c08]
ANATOMY: respectful fully clothed adult human-form divine queen, one head, two eyes, exactly TWO arms and TWO hands; modest opaque crimson sari completely covers torso and legs, regal antique gold embroidery, substantial royal gold crown wider than her head, heavy gold earrings. The specific crown and costume are editorial royal imagery based on queen status, not a claim of literal iconographic attributes. [radha-c01, radha-c08]
MOMENT: Sweep through a powerful rasa-dance turn toward the viewer, one open hand reaching outward across the near foreground and the other gathering the flowing sari near her hip; torso twists, shoulder and skirt pull diagonally across the square, face turned down toward the viewer with intense commanding yet compassionate devotional eyes. She is Raseshvari, queen of the Raslila, and Rasa-priya, fond of the rasa dance. Capture the instant of dance, not a static frontal portrait. [radha-c17, radha-c03]
POWER: No documented visible physical magical power in these claims. NO supernatural effects. Her sacred authority is conveyed by active royal movement, foreground foreshortening, crown, and concentrated natural illumination only; no glowing skin, no luminous halo, no light emitted from her hands or body.
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low viewpoint almost beneath the forward hand; VERY tight imposing three-quarter portrait from sweeping skirt at the lower edge through the complete uncut crown near the upper edge, Radha occupies ninety percent of the image, crown and face immediately readable as sacred royalty at thumbnail size. Apparent monumentality by framing and foreshortening, NOT literal gigantic anatomy. No distant small woman, no garden promenade, no bystanders, no additional deities.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one narrow natural golden sunset shaft from upper left through woodland, sharp gold rim along crown and billowing cloth, deep walnut shadows around her; airborne ordinary wind-blown spring petals confined to the edges, no decorative circle or aura behind her head.
SURFACE: rich woven silk under tension, dark crimson folds, embossed antique gold ornaments, tactile embroidered cloth, realistic skin rendered with visible painterly brushwork; deep warm colors, not plastic glamour.
SETTING: fragments of dark spring woodland and blossoms only at the edges, taken from the Gita Govinda woodland episode; no invented palace or generic garden architecture. [radha-c15]
MOOD: overwhelming, awe-inspiring, imposing sacred majesty, compassionate and devotional rather than frightening; respectful living Hindu religion; never cute, neutral, passive, calm or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: original design; no text, lettering, pseudo-script embroidery, logos, borders, frames, watermark or artist signature; no extra heads, arms, hands, fingers, eyes or wings; no weapons or magical objects; no borrowed movie/game/anime/comic design; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, beams, floating runes or energy ribbons. Exactly one square image.
